test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined idiom/phrase in the given sentence.

You cannot __throw dust into my eyes__.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4 i.e. **mislead or deceive me.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **"throw dust into my eyes"** means to mislead or deceive someone (मुझे धोखा देना या गुमराह करना).

 
 
• **Example:** No matter how hard you try, you cannot throw dust into my eyes.
